rationale: Task T7 requires an early-warning model for high-cost claims (top 5% by paid amount) for nurse review. Plan: (1) load input data from medical_claims; (2) 25% test holdout using run seed per task requirement; (3) target as paid_amount > 95th percentile across all data; (4) comprehensive feature set covering clinical (cpt_category, primary_icd10_cm, drg_present, place_of_service, er_flag, elective_flag, preventive_flag), operational (provider_specialty, network_status, auth_required_flag, service_units, length_of_stay), and financial context (billed_amount, allowed_amount, member_oop, cob_amount)—avoiding target and identifier leakage; (5) one-hot encode categoricals fitted on all data, no scaling for tree compatibility; (6) logistic regression and random forest for ranking model comparison; (7) report with model_limitations caveat, denominator notation for clarity, and artifact citations per standard practice. Retrieved skill on descriptive_only does not apply to predictive modeling task.
